name: Aerial
description: In the retrieved Aerial checkout, Sparkle is configured with an HTTPS appcast and a bundled SUPublicEDKey. Update preferences expose a check-for-updates setting and a notify/install mode; the checked-in documentation describes an optional silent install path while the screen saver runs. Sparkle framework enforcement and historical release artifacts were not independently reverified.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; Sparkle internals, published bundle signatures, and the companion updater are outside this source-only review.
